pageDescription: Define which lines each group of users can use in the widget. With no groups, every user can use every line.
firstGroupWarning: When you create the first group, users who are not in any group can no longer use any line in the widget. Add everyone who needs to send messages.
noLinesWarning: This group has no lines: its users cannot send messages through the widget.
empty: No groups created. Every user can use every line.
loadError: Could not load the access groups.
adminOnly: Only administrators can manage access groups.
